description: We are Team Astravion, passionate about space exploration, astronomy, and technology. Our project combines real NASA data, interactive 3D visualization, and scientific calculations to make Solar System exploration accessible to everyone. We welcome creative and motivated participants interested in web development, 3D modeling, UI/UX design, astronomy, astrophysics, data analysis, and scientific research. We value teamwork, innovation, problem-solving, and a willingness to learn. Join us now.
summary:
Astravion – Explore the Solar System Like Never Before

Astravion is an interactive, data-driven Solar System explorer designed to make space science exciting, understandable, and accessible to everyone. Our project transforms complex astronomical information into an immersive experience using real NASA data and interactive 3D visualization.

Users can explore all eight planets and the Moon, discover their current orbital positions, calculate real-time distances between Earth and other planets, and view authentic space images from NASA. Astravion also features a space exploration timeline covering 400 years of discoveries and an archive of 14 space missions.

Our goal is to bridge the gap between complex scientific data and everyday understanding. By turning astronomical numbers and information into visual and interactive experiences, Astravion helps students, space enthusiasts, and curious minds understand the incredible scale and beauty of our Solar System.
details:
What Does Astravion Do and How Does It Work?

Astravion is a web-based platform that brings the Solar System to life through interactive 3D visualization and real astronomical data. Instead of presenting users with complicated scientific numbers, it allows them to explore space visually and understand the information through simple explanations.

The platform offers several key features:

  • Interactive 3D Solar System: Explore all eight planets and the Moon in a rotating 3D environment. Users can zoom, rotate, hover over planets, and select them to discover more information. Planet sizes are represented proportionally to their real diameters.
  • Live Planetary Positions: Our custom orbital calculation system uses Kepler's equations and JPL orbital elements to calculate planetary positions based on the current date.
  • Distance Calculator: Calculate the current distance between Earth and other planets, along with estimated space travel times to make enormous astronomical distances easier to understand.
  • NASA Image Gallery: Discover authentic space photographs retrieved through NASA's Images API.
  • 400-Year Exploration Timeline: Travel through the history of Solar System discoveries and learn how our understanding of space has developed over time.
  • Space Missions Archive: Explore information about 14 space missions and learn more about humanity's journey into space.

Benefits and Intended Impact

Astravion makes astronomy easier to understand by transforming complex scientific information into an engaging visual experience. It helps students learn about planets, orbital movements, distances, and space exploration without requiring advanced scientific knowledge.

Our intended impact is to encourage curiosity about space, support science education, and make NASA's publicly available information more accessible to people around the world. We want users not only to read about the Solar System but also to experience and explore it themselves.

Technologies and Tools Used

We selected modern web technologies to build a responsive, interactive, and data-driven experience.

  • Next.js 15: Main web development framework.
  • React 19: Builds interactive user interfaces and dynamic components.
  • TypeScript: Helps maintain reliable code and prevent programming errors.
  • Three.js and React Three Fiber: Power the interactive 3D Solar System.
  • Tailwind CSS: Creates the visual design and responsive layout.
  • NASA APIs: Provide authentic NASA space images and related astronomical resources.
  • Custom Kepler Solver: Uses Kepler's equations and JPL orbital elements to calculate planetary positions.
  • Vercel: Hosts and deploys our live website.

What Makes Astravion Creative and Unique?

The main creativity behind Astravion is the way it combines real astronomical calculations, NASA resources, and interactive 3D technology into one learning platform.

Rather than simply displaying planets and scientific facts, we created an experience where users can explore the Solar System, understand planetary distances, discover real space images, and travel through the history of space exploration.

We also focused on making the experience visually attractive, easy to navigate, and accessible to users without a background in astronomy.

Factors We Considered During Development

Throughout development, our team focused on scientific reliability, user experience, accessibility, performance, and responsive design. We avoided using fixed or randomly assigned planetary positions and developed our own orbital calculation system using astronomical elements.

We also considered compatibility between modern technologies, reliable data handling, website performance, and a clean interface that works across different screen sizes.
